# External Evidence Index

These artifacts are redacted, operator-maintained release evidence. They do
not contain credentials and are not generated by local tests.

For a single gate, set `OGL_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_GATES=<gate-id>`.

Hosted deploy preflight and smoke: `pnpm hosted:deploy-gate:preflight`, `pnpm hosted:deploy-gate:smoke`, `pnpm hosted:deploy-gate:scheduler-packet`, `pnpm hosted:cron-evidence:artifact-hints`, `pnpm hosted:deploy-gate:packet`.

| Gate | Artifact | Status command | Preflight command |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hosted-supabase-cron` | `docs/verification/external/hosted-supabase-cron.md` | `OGL_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_GATES=hosted-supabase-cron pnpm external:evidence:worklist` | `OGL_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_GATES=hosted-supabase-cron pnpm external:evidence:preflight` |
| `provider-live-integrations` | `docs/verification/external/provider-live-integrations.md` | `OGL_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_GATES=provider-live-integrations pnpm external:evidence:worklist` | `OGL_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_GATES=provider-live-integrations pnpm external:evidence:preflight` |
| `hardware-os-e2e` | `docs/verification/external/hardware-os-e2e.md` | `OGL_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_GATES=hardware-os-e2e pnpm external:evidence:worklist` | `OGL_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_GATES=hardware-os-e2e pnpm external:evidence:preflight` |
| `rollout-tracks` | `docs/verification/external/rollout-tracks.md` | `OGL_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_GATES=rollout-tracks pnpm external:evidence:worklist` | `OGL_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_GATES=rollout-tracks pnpm external:evidence:preflight` |

The Store is a hosted catalog and redirect surface with wishlist and reviews. `sync-store-catalog` materializes ITAD discovery/prices and IGDB
metadata into `store_catalog`. Each game opens its official platform store. OG
Launcher does not sell games and has no cart, checkout, payment webhooks,
licenses, invoices, refunds, or developer-publishing flow.

For the final release boundary, run:

```bash
pnpm completion:gate:status
pnpm completion:gate:external
```
